_notes: Enhancement parents that Cyberpunk RED - Core 0.92.4 ships no item for. The build keeps Corgo's name and each affected item says the parent has to be made by hand; validate.mjs counts these as resolved. Anything not listed here has to match a real item name, so a typo or a rename fails the build.

absent.Monowire: Cyberarm option from Corgo's required content (Edgerunners Mission Kit); no item in 0.92.4, and its Cybersnake and Wolvers are different weapons rather than a stand-in.
absent.Self-ICE: Neuralware from Corgo's required content; no item in 0.92.4 under any name.
absent.Neuroport Cyberdeck Port: The 2077-era in-head cyberdeck port. 0.92.4 has Cyberdeck (Hardwired) and Black Chrome's Integrated Cyberdeck Upgrade, which is a Cyberarm option for a hardwired deck, so neither is this.
